lessons.title: Avoid heredocs for long interactive terminal payloads
lessons.failure_signature: An interactive shell remains at a heredoc continuation prompt because a long pasted payload was truncated or its delimiter was not received.
symptoms: The prompt changes to heredoc>.
Only the first part of a generated file is visible in the terminal.
Commands after the heredoc never execute.
lessons.root_cause: Large nested multiline payloads are fragile when pasted into an interactive shell, especially when they contain Markdown fences, quotes, or additional heredocs.
known_resolution: Interrupt the incomplete heredoc.
Verify repository state before retrying.
Deliver the implementation as a downloadable script.
Use a short one-line script invocation.
preventive_control: Do not use heredocs for large Kalaxy3 terminal workflows.
Generate downloadable, self-validating scripts instead.
Keep direct terminal commands short and read-only when possible.
preflight_detection: Flag requests that propose heredocs or large multiline terminal pastes.
Require a downloadable script when generated content is substantial.

lessons.title: Do not use zsh special parameter names as loop variables
lessons.failure_signature: Commands such as git, grep, and python3 become unavailable after a zsh loop assigns filenames to the variable path.
symptoms: git, grep, and python3 report command not found.
The prompt hook reports pyenv command not found.
PATH contains filenames from the loop instead of executable directories.
lessons.root_cause: In zsh, path is a special array tied directly to PATH. Assigning to path replaces the executable search path.
known_resolution: Start a fresh login shell with exec /bin/zsh -l.
Use names such as FILE_PATH or ITEM_PATH instead of path.
Verify command -v git, grep, python3, and bash.
preventive_control: Reserve path and other shell-special names in zsh workflows.
Use uppercase descriptive loop variables in pasted shell commands.
preflight_detection: Reject generated zsh loops matching for path in.
Lint shell snippets for assignments to zsh special parameters.

lessons.title: Preserve porcelain status prefixes when parsing Git state
lessons.failure_signature: A changed-path validator drops the first filename character and reports a false scope mismatch.
symptoms: sage-change-authority.json is displayed as age-change-authority.json.
A valid one-file correction fails changed-path validation.
lessons.root_cause: The parser stripped leading whitespace before removing the two-character Git status plus separator.
known_resolution: Use git diff --name-only, git diff --cached --name-only, and git ls-files.
When porcelain output is required, preserve the leading status columns.
preventive_control: Prefer dedicated Git name-only commands over manual porcelain slicing.
Test parsers with both staged and unstaged single-character-leading filenames.
preflight_detection: Mutation-test status lines beginning with a leading space.
Require expected and actual path-set comparison before mutation.

lessons.title: Preserve repository formatting to avoid review-obscuring churn
lessons.failure_signature: A semantically small JSON change appears as hundreds of insertions and deletions because the entire file was reformatted.
symptoms: Commit statistics are much larger than the intended change.
Reviewers cannot distinguish semantic edits from whitespace churn.
lessons.root_cause: The writer used a different indentation convention than the repository-owned file.
known_resolution: Compare parsed JSON before and after to confirm semantic scope.
Restore the repository's existing indentation.
Validate the correction with git diff -w.
preventive_control: Detect and preserve the existing file's serialization style.
Review numstat and whitespace-insensitive diffs before committing.
preflight_detection: Fail when a small semantic edit rewrites most of a canonical registry.
Compare parsed payloads to expected semantic transformations.

lessons.title: Fetch and revalidate remote state before every cohesive mutation
lessons.failure_signature: A local implementation is based on stale main or stale feature-branch state after automation or another actor advances the remote.
symptoms: Local and remote SHAs differ unexpectedly.
Generated-document automation advances origin/main after publication.
A subsequent commit is built against an obsolete baseline.
lessons.root_cause: Remote state was assumed rather than fetched and compared immediately before mutation.
known_resolution: Run git fetch origin.
Compare local HEAD, origin/feature branch, and origin/main to expected SHAs.
Stop and rediscover authority when the baseline advances.
preventive_control: Require clean, synchronized feature branches before every cohesive edit.
Push each validated cohesive commit immediately.
Revalidate when origin/main changes.
preflight_detection: Check origin/main and the active feature branch against the expected SHAs before mutation.
Check exact local and remote SHAs before mutation.
Fail closed on nonzero feature-branch divergence.

lessons.title: Use the repository kubeconfig instead of assuming the k3s default path
lessons.failure_signature: Controller-side Kubernetes validation fails because the workflow assumes a server-local k3s kubeconfig path.
symptoms: kubectl cannot reach the cluster from the controller.
The expected /etc/rancher/k3s/k3s.yaml file is absent locally.
lessons.root_cause: The controller and k3s server have different filesystem and credential contexts.
known_resolution: Use the repository-owned controller kubeconfig.
Pass KUBECONFIG explicitly to controller-side commands.
Use remote k3s kubectl only for remote-host validation.
preventive_control: Separate controller and remote execution paths.
Never infer kubeconfig location from k3s defaults.
preflight_detection: Verify the selected kubeconfig exists before cluster commands.
Print the active kubectl context during validation.

lessons.title: Do not use standard input for both Python code and piped data
lessons.failure_signature: A Python command receives either its program text or piped JSON, but not both, causing empty input or syntax failures.
symptoms: The JSON parser receives no data.
Python interprets piped JSON as source code.
A validation pipeline fails despite valid upstream output.
lessons.root_cause: python - consumes standard input as program source, leaving no independent standard-input channel for piped data.
known_resolution: Use python -c for inline code that reads stdin.
Write code to a temporary or downloadable script.
Pass data through a file or command argument.
preventive_control: Do not combine a Python-source heredoc with piped JSON.
Choose one explicit channel for code and another for data.
preflight_detection: Flag pipelines combining a pipe with python - and a heredoc.
Test pipelines with representative nonempty JSON.

lessons.title: Use stabilization windows before classifying logging startup failures
lessons.failure_signature: Immediate post-deployment logging checks report transient 429 responses, old timestamps, or startup pressure that clears after the system stabilizes.
symptoms: Collectors retry during Loki startup.
Recent-query checks initially return old data.
Resources become ready but telemetry is not yet representative.
lessons.root_cause: Readiness and useful steady-state behavior occur on different timelines for stateful logging components.
known_resolution: Separate immediate readiness from stabilization validation.
Repeat log freshness and error checks after the stabilization window.
Record both transient and steady-state behavior.
preventive_control: Require baseline, immediate, stabilization, and trend windows.
Do not classify transient startup pressure as a persistent defect.
preflight_detection: Require an explicit stabilization duration in logging validation plans.
Check restart counts, recent timestamps, and errors after stabilization.

lessons.title: Execute generated Python helper runtime paths before delivery
lessons.failure_signature: A generated Python helper passes syntax compilation but fails when an exercised reporting or checksum path references a module or name that was never imported.
symptoms: The helper performs useful work and then raises NameError.
Checksum or terminal reporting fails after output files exist.
Repeated helpers fail on the same missing runtime import.
lessons.root_cause: Syntax compilation validates parsing and bytecode generation but does not execute late runtime paths or resolve referenced global names.
known_resolution: Add the missing import or runtime dependency.
Validate any already-written output before retrying mutation.
Run a focused executable self-test covering reporting and checksum paths.
preventive_control: Require generated helpers to expose and pass a runtime self-test before delivery.
Run py_compile plus the declared self-test; neither alone is sufficient.
Verify the delivered helper digest before invocation.
preflight_detection: Execute a negative fixture whose reporting path references an unimported module and require the validator to reject it.
Fail helper delivery when any declared terminal path has not executed successfully.

lessons.title: Retrieve repository experience after the first unexpected failure
lessons.failure_signature: An unexpected implementation or validation failure is followed by another correction without first retrieving prior evidence, lessons, actionable failures, and canonical recovery or inspecting the authoritative production contract.
symptoms: Multiple recovery helpers fail on related parser assumptions.
Synthetic fixtures pass while production loads zero records.
Formatted command output is treated as a stable interface.
Avoidable rework accumulates before evidence is consulted.
lessons.root_cause: The first failure was treated as an isolated defect rather than a trigger to consult SAGE engineering memory and repository authority before another mutation.
known_resolution: Stop further mutation after the first unexpected failure.
Retrieve evidence, lessons, failures, and canonical recovery.
Inspect the authoritative production contract.
Build the correction and regression from that contract.
preventive_control: Validator failures invoke retrieval before retry guidance.
Write a local receipt showing consulted ranked experience.
A second same-class failure requires a lesson or action.
preflight_detection: Require a retrieval receipt before retry guidance.
Test the actual dotted-key actionable-failure registry.
Reject relevance created only by ranking bonuses.

lessons.title: Align retrieval quality fixtures with production relevance gates
lessons.failure_signature: A retrieval quality test expects a record under a request whose active domain groups the record does not satisfy, so production relevance filtering removes the record before metadata assertions run.
symptoms: A candidate-specific next call raises StopIteration.
The fixture record exists in the source registry.
The request activates Grafana or logging domain gates.
The lesson fixture contains validation terms but no Grafana or logging terms.
lessons.root_cause: The test combined quality-field assertions for records from different relevance domains in one query and assumed all fixtures would be returned.
known_resolution: Use a Grafana and logging query for the evidence record.
Use a lesson and validation query for the lesson record.
Validate each payload independently under production domain-group semantics.
Report candidate identifiers before candidate-specific metadata assertions.
preventive_control: Generated retrieval helpers must exercise the complete production relevance gate in a detached worktree.
Test fixtures must state the request and expected active groups for every asserted candidate.
Quality-field tests must not use an unguarded next call for a candidate whose inclusion has not been asserted.
preflight_detection: Run the source-only retrieval suite against the patched production policy in a detached worktree.
Assert fixture request groups before candidate-specific metadata checks.
Include the observed candidate identifier set when a required fixture is absent.
